changes.before: Pending as of 2026-09-23. At its August 18, 2026 regular meeting, the Cromwell Planning and Zoning Commission voted 5-1 to accept Application #26-25 (the proposed 12-month data center moratorium text amendment) and schedule it for a public hearing at a Special Meeting on September 24, 2026 -- the Commission did not adopt the moratorium at the August 18 meeting itself. Staff confirmed no data center application is currently pending, though one commissioner referenced an interested prospective applicant. A secondary aggregator (mytownview.com) inaccurately described this August 18 procedural vote as the Commission having 'approved' and 'passed' the moratorium itself; the official filed minutes make clear only the scheduling of a hearing was voted on.
